packages.name: kaivideo
packages.title: KaiVideo
packages.author: Mizuiro
packages.description: Video player for Switch 2 with Jellyfin support: your films and series from the SD card or a Jellyfin server, hardware decoding (H.264, VP9, AV1), HEVC on the CPU, 4K and HDR through the server, subtitles, sound tracks, resume and next episode.
